blocks.title: Object-Oriented Programming
blocks.text: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) code ko design aur munazzam karne ka tareeqa hai jo use sambhalna aur samajhna aasan banata hai, cheezon ki numaindagi karne wale objects se bana kar.
Socheye ke aap khilono ki eenton se namoone ka shehar bana rahe hain: har imarat, gari aur shakhs alag cheez hai jise aap design aur istemal kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Namoone ke shehar ki tasveer mein har imarat ya gari OOP mein kis cheez ki numaindagi karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Object: apne data aur rawayye wali alag cheez.

items: OOP: code ko objects ki shakal mein munazzam karna, namoone ke shehar ki alag imaraton, gariyon aur logon ki tarah.
